areas.georgetown: Meet Penang’s city side: Komtar and the heritage quarter. Open a numbered landmark to discover its story.
areas.gurney: Look closer at the waterfront skyline, hotels and shopping around Gurney and Tanjung Tokong.
areas.batu-kawan: Explore a modern mainland neighbourhood around IKEA and outlet shopping in Batu Kawan.
areas.ferringhi: Follow the northern coast to Batu Ferringhi, with beaches and seaside stays.
areas.penang-hill: Head for hilltop views and a different side of the island. Select Penang Hill for official visitor information.
areas.air-itam: Discover temple architecture in Air Itam. Open Kek Lok Si to plan a visit.
areas.teluk-bahang: A corner of Penang for nature and adventure, with Entopia and ESCAPE nearby.
areas.queensbay: Discover the modern southeast: Queensbay, neighbourhoods and the business districts around Bayan Baru.
areas.butterworth: Look across the strait to Butterworth, Penang Sentral and the mainland waterfront.
areas.bukit-mertajam: Make room for the mainland: Bukit Mertajam’s town, local food and neighbourhood discoveries.
